title: Density gap bounded by derivative gaps
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\psi$ be a nonnegative function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ with uniform mean $1$, and let $F\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $|F(x)|=1$ for every $x$. Write $\mathbb E$ for uniform expectation and $\mathbb E_\psi g=\mathbb E_x[\psi(x)g(x)]$; for $y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, set $D_yF(x)=F(x+y)F(x)$. Then $|\mathbb E F|\,|\mathbb E_\psi F-\mathbb E F|\leq\mathbb E_y|\mathbb E_\psi D_yF-\mathbb E_x D_yF(x)|$.
hypotheses_covered: $F\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ is sign-valued: $|F(x)|=1$ for every $x$
